 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The SMU Mustangs face what may be their toughest and most important game of the season as they welcome Wake Forest to Gerald J. Ford Stadium on Saturday.
 With the Mustangs in desperate need of going on a run, and Wake Forest, who, at 8-1, have ripped through college football over the past month, this has all the makings of a titanic battle.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Simply put, a win for the Mustangs would keep Rhett Lashlee's team in the race for the ACC Championship, but a loss would all but end their hopes.
 So yeah, no pressure.
 READ MORE: SMU's Road to Charlotte Runs Through Wake Forest ... With No Margin for Error 
 We know that Wake Forest boasts one of the best offenses in college football, averaging 43 points per game, and one of the best defenses in college football, so how the Mustangs navigate that will be a fascinating watch.
 Lashlee called Wake Forest a "complete" team earlier in the week, and quarterback Kevin Jennings is ready for a hard, physical battle, so the Mustangs have to bring their best, despite being at home, to get the win here.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Mustangs have lost just once out of their last six games, while Wake Forest hasn't lost since September 18 against Florida.
 So, this game pits two teams that consider themselves ACC heavyweights this season against each other, with Lashlee's team looking to avoid a 2026 knockout punch from Jake Dickert's team.
 READ MORE: SMU's Kevin Jennings Outlines Key Wake Forest Trait Ahead Of ACC Showdown 
 Jennings and the offense will have to play a clean football game if SMU is to stand a chance here, and defensively, they have to find a way to slow down quarterback Gio Lopez and star receiver Carlos Hernandez (945 yards, 7 TDs).
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement It is all or nothing for the 7-2 Mustangs on Saturday with their championship hopes hanging on the next four quarters of football.
 And they couldn't have got a tougher test.
 But if Lashlee can mastermind a win, then the entire narrative around the Mustangs in 2026 will shift dramatically.
 - WHEN : 11:00 a.m. CT
 - WHERE : Gerald J. Ford Stadium, Dallas
 - TV : ESPN
 - STREAMING : Fubo, Disney+, the ESPN App
 - RADIO : SMU Athletics (Sportsradio 96.7 FM / 1310 AM The Ticket, SiriusXM)
 ODDS VIA DRAFTKINGS :
 - SPREAD : SMU -1 (-108) | Wake Forest +1 (-110)
 - MONEYLINE : SMU -110 | Wake Forest -108
 - TOTAL POINTS : 61.5
